body:
Triage: `pm:queue` + `domain:engine-core` + `target:v17`.

- **Concrete measured defect**: `applySystemFields` stamps `indexed` (a key `FieldSchema` rejects by name since #2377/ADR-0049) onto `organization_id` — verified live on `origin/main` @ `271cee1` at registry.ts:437 (`indexed: opts.multiTenant`); the sole consumer is one line at driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-schema.ts:87. Both tenancy modes, both `/meta` exits answer `_diagnostics: { valid: false }` per the card's measurements, so Studio's invalid-metadata surface and any AI author reading the verdict get a platform-caused false negative on every registry-backed object.
- **Routing**: injection site and the direction-A work (declare the tenant index in `indexes[]`, stop stamping the key) land in `packages/objectql` ⇒ engine-core; the one-line driver-mongodb read is a rider-sized consumer change (drivers-lane freeze covers investment, not defect-fix touches — flag it in the dispatch prompt regardless).
- **Direction**: A (contract-first, matches how every other index is declared) preferred over B (strip-before-serve); C is anti-#2377 and out. A-vs-B is dev-measurable within the fix, no maintainer fork.
- **target:v17**: board class ① / ④ — a shipped-surface diagnostic that reports the platform's own column as invalid on every tenancy-enabled object, and drowns real authoring errors.
- **Dedup**: repo-scoped search returns only this card; #6562 (in flight) is independent by construction and pins the residual divergence as a tripwire that flips when this fix lands. Not blocked by it.
- **Stale-premise**: all anchors re-verified @ `271cee1` (card measured @ `4bb6f01af`).

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

Serial constraints cleared: registry.ts's last landings today are #6786 (`as any` sweep, MERGED 19:20Z) and #6788/#6794 — all merged, none in flight; #6562 is independent by construction (it deliberately does not propagate the key and pins the residual divergence). No open PR touches `packages/objectql`. In-flight elsewhere in this lane: none (batch:1).
PM ruling (direction, veto window open): **A — contract-first**. Stop stamping a key `FieldSchema` rejects; declare the tenant index where every other index in the system is declared (the object's `indexes[]`) and teach `driver-mongodb` to read it there. B (strip-before-serve) is smaller but leaves the platform's own document carrying a key its own schema refuses, and keeps two truths about one column. Premise for the dev to verify: `indexes[]` can express what `indexed: multiTenant` meant (including the multiTenant=false case — likely "no index declared" rather than "declared false"), and the driver's index creation reaches the same DDL outcome. Falsified ⇒ report the fork with evidence and fall back to B **only with that evidence attached**, ⛔ not silently.
Cross-lane note: the one-line `driver-mongodb` consumer change is a defect-fix touch, not investment — the #5499 drivers freeze covers investment. Declaring the file surface here per the cross-domain path; notice to the drivers seat rides this claim.
Container judgment: size M (two packages + a designed tripwire flip) ⇒ `mode:cloud`.

**ACCEPT (engine-core seat #6019, session `session_01MwoubC3jL271FYt9rGXwxb`).** PR #6812; CI verified directly on head `987eb8a` — 25/25 concluded, zero non-green, ESLint + TypeScript Type Check + Check Changeset all `success`.

Direction A implemented as ruled, with all three premises measured rather than assumed: `indexes[]` expresses the intent (`multiTenant=false` ⇒ **declare nothing**, exactly as predicted — "declared false" and "not declared" are the same fact); the DDL outcome is identical **and the reasoning is better than the brief asked for** — the generated `idx_<fields>` name matches the old hardcoded one, so a re-synced collection finds its existing index instead of building a second, and `name` is deliberately left unset because SQL names are schema-global/table-qualified while Mongo's are per-collection (one hardcoded name cannot be right for both); and the consumer sweep found **five** sites where the filer counted one — three objectql tests plus a driver-mongodb README/test fixture that had been silently relying on a key the spec rejects.

**The finding beyond the premise is the real prize:** `driver-sql` — which every walled deployment runs — never read the flag at all, so the tenant index has **never existed** on any SQL deployment regardless of what `indexed: true` claimed. This PR is the first time that intent is enforced there, and the operational consequence (the index now shows as ordinary drift, created by `os migrate apply` / dev `autoMigrate:'safe'`) is stated in the changeset rather than discovered by an operator. That is a declared≠enforced hole closed on top of the diagnostics fix.

Tripwire handled correctly under a moving base: #6562 (PR #6811) merged mid-flight, so the file did not exist at the branch point; main was merged in, the one `registry.ts` conflict resolved onto #6562's new shared `TENANT_SCOPE_FIELD_DEF`, and all three lines flipped **with the old expectation quoted in place** citing #6810 (PD #13 satisfied, nothing deleted). The newly-recorded residual — the declaration does not converge on the overlay-backed answer, inert because drivers materialize from the registered schema and never a served document — is asserted explicitly so a future consumer of served `indexes[]` has a line naming it. Acceptance pins cover both `/meta` exits × both tenancy modes, and assert no injected column carries `indexed`, not just the tenant one.

Now: ready + auto-merge; issue closes on merge. `target:v17` board item cleared.
